note: Every entry MUST have a real reason, a technicalOwner, a riskAcceptedBy, and an expiresAt. Expiries are capped at 90 days from the date of the last review — a longer horizon requires a new triage. `technicalOwner` is the developer/security lead responsible for watching upstream for a patched release; `riskAcceptedBy` is the business owner who approved carrying the residual risk. When expiresAt passes, CI fails again until the entry is renewed or resolved. Full analysis lives in docs/SECURITY-ADVISORIES.md.
